title: Months Of The Year
materials: Household rhythm sticks or wooden spoons
quest_mission: Join Elias & Selene in Celestia on an acoustic sensory quest to explore Months Of The Year.
rhythm_ignition: Teacher models a steady 2-minute rhythmic call-and-response beat to 'Months Of The Year', synchronizing clapping and vocal chanting with the children.
tactile_ritual:
The Hands-On Sensory Discovery:
1. Children gather in a circle with tactile items.
2. Follow the musical cues of Months Of The Year to touch, sort, and move in rhythmic unison.
3. Pair high-reach movements with deep somatic exhalations.
4. Freeze in quiet stillness at the final chord.

domain_spider.language: Articulate clear auditory phrasing and target vocabulary connected to Months Of The Year.
domain_spider.cognitive: Identify rhythmic patterns, tempo shifts, and conceptual categories in Celestia.
domain_spider.physical: Gross motor whole-body balance, bilateral coordination, and fine motor finger rhythm.
domain_spider.science_sensory: Tactile exploration of real-world materials and acoustic auditory pitch discrimination.
domain_spider.social_emotional: Cooperative participation, shared attentional focus, and calming self-regulation.

teacher_whisper: Auditory rhythmic pacing stimulates brainstem regulation and synchronizes attention across the classroom without visual screen fatigue.

standards.kindergarten_readiness: Orders 12-month calendar progression through rhythmic recall and connects months to personal milestones.
